notes.title: Quick Fix V1.3.12
notes.content:
-Removed auto-save feature for level 1
-Removed experimental sub-system
-More minor tweaks
-Removed out-dated game files for unused objects

Added a new trailer for the game to showcase new level features for Time-Skip. Changed minor things as well as removed experimental transportation's sub-system, making the game code more stable. The trailer was recorded with the current version 9/23/2018. Let's try and sell a few thousand units of Time-Skip in the next few months! This is a really great game!

notes.title: Update V1.3 for Time-Skip is now is now available!
notes.content:
The following is a list of updates that have recently been added to Time Skip! 

Version 1.3.0:

-Auto-save feature added.
-Added new function subsystem to prevent rare flukes in-game.
-Slightly Increased midair mobility.
-Sound volumes equalized.
-Added more props to levels.
-Minor fine-tuning & micro adjustments.

tags.feature: -Added new function subsystem to prevent rare flukes in-game.

notes.title: Patch notes & future concepts
notes.content:
It has been great working on Time Skip, Level 9 is about 50% completed, however if sales/reviews don't improve then it will probably remain this way for a while. Everything takes time, and it takes a few months to reach this point. I need you to like & tell everyone and buy this game to support more indie developers. Thanks!

Update 1.2.92

-Greatly improved teleportation accuracy/reliability (Finely-tuned)

-Added more pipes/props

-Turret can no longer track player at 'real-time' speeds while slow-motion is 
active.

-Added some lights

-Added dirt & level effects for level 4

tags.balance_change:
-Turret can no longer track player at 'real-time' speeds while slow-motion is 
active.

notes.title: HD - Update V1.2.5
notes.content:
The following improvements have been made to Time Skip:

-Final production of lighting quality.

-Fine-tuning of game-play & visual appearance.

-Camera/Monitor display will no longer rotate camera feed with player’s 
perspective.

-Increased laser rotation speed w/ reflectors.

-Level 3 added objects to help prevent player short-cut.

-Level 4 Added an invisible wall to blast shield.

-Level 6 Moved objects, added more props to prevent short-cut.

-Level 7 Removed lag at beginning of level. Added sparks. Added some lasers.

notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
The following improvements have been made for Time Skip Version 1.9:
-Dramatic efficiency in-game reducing triangles.
-Major lighting improvements.
-Reduced lag some players were experiencing when creating platforms.
-Settings menu now available in-game instead of only the main menu.
-Settings now has FPS counter.
-Improved spark laser trail effect.
-Lasers will not interfere with other lasers spark trail effect.
-Monitor/Camera system added to game.
-Moved several props causing screen tearing.
-Added more props
-Failure screen now fades view & sound.
-Overall new game engine updated & performance increase.

tags.balance_change: -Reduced lag some players were experiencing when creating platforms.
